mesajlar.mesaj:
Dear citizens,

The cowardly enemies of Galloway continue to target our market with their puppet, Makuta. Please do not post the following items in the market, but prefer to rely on market requests to ask for what you need and sell to those that need it:

Any food

Raw materials including wood, wheat, flour, wool and hides

Most clothing items needed for levelling up (skirts, shirts, trousers, hoses, shoes, hats).

If you find items that are being purchased in bulk by this individual or other suspicious people, please report the name of the buyer and the goods purchased directly to me.
